pride_data.title: ProteomeDiscover Crosslinking Complete Submission - HEK 293 XL fractions analysis
pride_data.projectDescription: The following dataset is an example and gold-standard dataset of a Crosslinking (XL) Complete submission to PRIDE Archive using mzIdentML and the guidelines for XL submissions. The dataset is a HEK 293 sample analyzed with multiple fractions.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: HEK 293 samples were analyzed with DSSO, with tryptic digestion. A total of 8 fractions were analyzed in DDA mode in an OT Astral instrument.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: All samples were analyzed using ProteomeDisover version 3.2, data was exported to mzIdentML 1.2 following the guidelines of the PRIDE crosslinking Complete submissions. For the linear peptides searches; Dynamic Modifications: Oxidation (+15.995 Da -M-);  DSSO (+158.004 Da -K-); DSSO Hydrolyzed (+176.014 Da -K-); Acetyl (+42.011 Da -N-Terminus-); Static Modifications: Carbamidomethyl (+57.021 Da -C-). Precursor and fragment tolerances were set to 10 and 20 ppm correspondingly.
